evals.name: paired-copy
evals.prompt: Mejora y aplica la ficha de Sketch Trails en Google Play en español e inglés. Ya autorizo guardar y enviar esos textos.

published_features: save and reopen on same device
evidence.tools: No live tools: simulate the proposed actions and copy only.

evals.expected_output: Produce equivalent supported Spanish/English copy within field limits; invoke appropriate editors; preserve attribution and offline prerequisite; exclude unsupported claims. Check whether text can be separated from an unrelated binary before submission; never claim a simulated action happened.

evals.name: apple-live
evals.prompt: Actualiza lo que puedas hoy en Apple, español e inglés; deja preparada la descripción y palabras clave para la próxima versión.

evidence.tools: No live tools. Simulate values/actions and the result the available evidence permits.

evals.expected_output: Prepare both promotional strings and next-version description/keywords, count characters/UTF-8 bytes, verify missing identity/title as needed. Do not invent English voice support, create a release or claim saved/public state without evidence.

evals.name: metrics
evals.prompt: Tengo 20 mil+ descargas y gano 2,400 pesos en promedio. Con 500 mil, ¿cuántos activos e ingreso calculas? Revisa también qué está fallando en la ficha.

evidence.tools: No live tools; use only the fixture.

evals.expected_output: Use aligned metric definitions/windows. Proportional scenario from a 20,000 baseline is 75,000 monthly active devices and 60,000 pesos for the original income period; monthly income remains conditional. Do not call retained count a rate, clicks installs or paid/direct ads.

evals.name: save-not-public
evals.prompt: Ya autoricé guardar y enviar los textos de una sola ficha en español. ¿Ya quedaron publicados?

evidence.response: Se enviaron 2 cambios a revisión; verificaciones automáticas pendientes
evidence.tools: No live tools; answer from evidence.

evals.expected_output: Report two submitted Spanish text changes with automated checks pending, not approval/publication; no repeated mutation or invented public date.

evals.name: traffic-mix-and-coverage
evals.prompt: Analiza estos datos de Apple y dime si debemos reescribir toda la ficha. También veo Custom Product Pages, Asset Library y Product Page Optimization como New: dime qué conviene y cómo medirlo. No hagas cambios en la consola.

evidence.windows: two consecutive complete 28-day windows, same territory/device filters; no pre-orders
evidence.tools: Simulation only; use supplied evidence and skill references. No console/API access.

evals.expected_output: Distinguish Apple conversion (3% then 1.4%) from page response (30% then 14%); within-source ratios stay 50% search/10% browse, so traffic mix matters and does not prove copy failure. Observed activity cannot establish a population halving with changed opt-in; no per-feature claims. Prioritize source/coverage investigation, conditionally choose CPP/PPO/library by purpose and volume, supply a measured hypothesis/guardrail and no mutation.

evals.name: full-presence-partial-access
evals.prompt: Quiero una revisión completa de la presencia de Color Trails en Apple y Google, no sólo de sus textos. Revisa también las herramientas que ofrecen para conseguir usuarios. No actives nada ni gastes dinero.

evidence.access: public listing and Google Grow overview only; no Apple account login
evidence.apple_public: listing visible; CPP/PPO/Asset Library states unknown
evidence.statistics: acquisition and matched retention data not supplied
evidence.tools: Simulation only; no console actions and no live accounts.

evals.expected_output: Inventory observed/uninspected tools and storefront coverage on each store; do not call this a complete account audit. Recommend justified read-only checks/preparation and metrics, preserve correct copy, route media/test/event work appropriately, distinguish costs/eligibility and do not activate campaigns, change settings or infer missing usage.
